name: @factory/app-server
description: Factory web host: Mastra entry (MastraFactory with GitHub and GitLab, Google sign-in) and host scenario tests.

scripts.dev:local: corepack pnpm sync:skills && rm -rf .mastra/output && mkdir -p $HOME/.mastracode/factory-v4 && NODE_ENV=development HOST=${HOST:-127.0.0.1} FACTORY_AUTH=google MASTRA_DB_PATH=${MASTRA_DB_PATH:-$HOME/.mastracode/factory-v4/mastra.db} MASTRACODE_UI_DIST=$PWD/../ui/dist PORT=${PORT:-5874} MASTRACODE_PUBLIC_URL=${MASTRACODE_PUBLIC_URL:-http://localhost:5874} varlock run -- mastra factory dev --dir src/mastra
scripts.dev:platform: corepack pnpm sync:skills && rm -rf .mastra/output && MASTRACODE_UI_DIST=$PWD/../ui/dist varlock run -- mastra factory dev --dir src/mastra
scripts.build: corepack pnpm sync:skills && mastra build --dir src/mastra && rm -rf .mastra/output/factory && cp -R ../ui/dist .mastra/output/factory && rm -rf src/mastra/public/factory
scripts.sync:skills: rm -rf src/mastra/public/factory-skills && mkdir -p src/mastra/public && cp -R ../../packages/harness-mastra/factory-skills src/mastra/public/factory-skills
